entries.detail: Validated for text chat (non-streaming and streaming), sampling (top_p/seed/stop applied; seeded determinism observed), json_schema structured output forwarded natively and validated after generation, hidden reasoning, cancellation, two concurrent streams, error mapping, lifecycle lease semantics, engine stop/restart, and mid-stream engine loss. (latest lane run here: deferred — this host can run the lane, but no --base-url/--model for an operator-started LewLM+engine was given)

lanes.title: Linux NVIDIA
lanes.required_proof: vLLM, SGLang, ExLlamaV3/TabbyAPI suites; llama.cpp CUDA offload/build/cache validation

entries.detail: Linux/NVIDIA validation host unavailable on 2026-09-18. The recipe in examples/backends/vllm/ is complete and pinned (release v0.29.0 = commit 98dff2a8; image vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:c2914767605584b6d8f45686b82de173ecc99e781897aa3d0a66dacd72c51ae1, CUDA 13.0.2, torch 2.13.0, TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST 7.5-12.0; every `vllm serve` argument checked against the commit; hermes tool parser per upstream's tool-calling doc for Qwen2.5), but nothing was executed. The BF16 model is a candidate, not yet validated by this engine. (latest lane run here: deferred — needs Linux, host is Darwin; needs a working NVIDIA driver (nvidia-smi: not found on PATH))

Linux/NVIDIA validation host unavailable on 2026-09-18. The recipe in examples/backends/sglang/ is complete and pinned (release v0.5.19 = commit 0bcd8223; image lmsysorg/sglang@sha256:d6e7288627be8b02be88e4bba38e73f6d50e2826869f753c13a4c4385ab3eda9, CUDA 13.0.3, torch 2.13.0, sglang-kernel 0.4.6.post1 prebuilt wheel; every launch_server argument checked against server_args.py at the commit; qwen25 tool parser and xgrammar grammar backend per upstream at that commit; torch.compile deliberately off), but nothing was executed. The BF16 model is a candidate, not yet validated by this engine.

Linux/NVIDIA validation host unavailable on 2026-09-17. The recipe in examples/backends/exllamav3-tabby/ is complete and pinned (image ghcr.io/theroyallab/tabbyapi@sha256:10bfcf9d27d1b3a5c7ada786f814b9da43fadad35643362f2fe0816082893172, built from the pinned commit on CUDA 12.8.1; config keys verified against config_sample.yml at that commit), but nothing was executed. The BF16 model is a conversion input; no EXL3 artifact has been produced or hashed.
